wins: Completed full reconnaissance cycle within first 8 steps, mapping 3 live hosts and 5 open services, which yielded high-fidelity service data.
Triggered repeatable mentor guidance quickly (10 calls) to validate approach and avoid major blind spots.
fails: Failed to exploit the highest-priority vulnerability due to lack of valid credentials in the post-exploitation phase, preventing success completion.
Did not leverage the documented misconfigured web endpoint despite recon confirming its presence, resulting in zero success rate.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance workflows were efficient and repeatable, but the run stalled in exploitation due to missed credential gathering and underutilized misconfigurations.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Inadequate credential harvesting before attempting exploitation of web application misconfiguration.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with nmap scripts and capture supported authentication mechanisms

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP service on port 80/443 shows candidate misconfiguration (e.g., directory listing, verbose error message)
skill_cards.then_action: Chain directory brute force (gobuster) with vulnerability fingerprinting tool (nikto) and log outputs

skill_cards.if_condition: Post reconnaissance detects login prompt without credentials
skill_cards.then_action: Deploy credential harvest via captured banner data and brute force from stored password lists

memory_ops.reason: High reliability in identifying SSH service details for later exploitation phases.
Consistent detection of exploitable misconfigurations across web services during recon.

next_experiments.title: Credential Harvesting Prior to Exploit
next_experiments.description: Automate extraction of stored credentials from reconnaissance outputs (e.g., SSH banners, web config leaks) before launching exploitation to ensure prerequisites are met.

next_experiments.title: Web Misconfiguration Exploitation Sequence
next_experiments.description: Integrate directory brute-forcing with automated vulnerability verification scripts to confidently assert exploitable misconfigurations and reduce manual oversight.

next_experiments.title: Mentor Call Decision Gate Tuning
next_experiments.description: Define criteria for when mentor input is required to minimize unnecessary disruptions while capturing actionable guidance earlier in failure cases.
